title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in Wolf Carpenters's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.
video_queries: how much does a kitchen remodel cost

voice.quem: Wolf Carpenters, a full in-house carpentry and remodeling contractor in Peabody, MA and the North Shore, known for craftsmanship with no subcontractors and no shortcuts.
voice.eixo_viral: Real transformations and honest craftsmanship: turning worn-out spaces into homes people love, with the trust of an in-house team that does it right.
voice.tom: Authoritative craftsman who educates and inspires: confident, warm, no jargon, proof over promises. Shows the work, explains the why, respects the homeowner's budget and time.
voice.gancho_formula: [bold claim or number] + [transformation or mistake] + [what the homeowner really gets]
voice.gancho_default: THE #1 REMODELING MISTAKE THAT COSTS HOMEOWNERS THOUSANDS
voice.alvo_default: North Shore homeowners planning a kitchen, bathroom or home renovation

alvo.homeowners: North Shore homeowners planning a remodel or addition
alvo.sellers: homeowners renovating to boost value before selling
alvo.design_lovers: people who love home design, before and after transformations

voice.angulo_corpo: Lead with the real problem or the eye-catching result, then teach one concrete thing (cost, timeline, material, mistake), then show why an in-house team makes the difference, close with a clear next step.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: Open on the dramatic before or the finished reveal in the first 2 seconds, narrate the build step by step, keep the craftsmanship visible, land on the transformation.
voice.angulo_fecho: Invite the homeowner to picture their own space done right, then point them to a free estimate or a message: no pressure, just craftsmanship they can trust.
